clips.title: The story
paras: Near Goldshire, Stormbrow the Elder waits beside the water during the Lunar Festival. Travelers honor ancient traditions and the olden races of Azeroth, and receive a token of remembrance in return.

A quiet pond lies just behind the smithy in Goldshire, where Stormbrow the Elder appears. Guards, tradesfolk, and weary travelers pass through town on their way into the forest. Beneath Elwynn Forest's canopy, the honored spirit welcomes anyone who comes to honor the realm's long history.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits of great ancestors return to walk among the living. Stormbrow the Elder commends travelers who remember those who came before. For honoring the wisdom and legacy of the elder peoples, he grants a blessing and a commemorative coin for the season.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
